correction_note_appended_2026-08-01.append_only_declaration: APPEND ONLY. Nothing above this note has been modified. Every field recording what happened during the 2026-07-31 rerun stands exactly as written, including the diagnosis now known to be wrong - the wrong diagnosis IS the record, and erasing it would hide how the error propagated across two runs.
correction_note_appended_2026-08-01.what_is_corrected: This manifest's stated diagnosis of the /vehicles failure. collections[0].cross_run_significance concludes that two independent runs failing identically is 'meaningfully stronger evidence of a persistent upstream fault specific to the vehicles collection at page[size]=200'. The reasoning was sound and the conclusion is WRONG.
correction_note_appended_2026-08-01.why_the_reasoning_failed: Both runs held page[size]=200 fixed. Repeating an identical request and observing an identical failure cannot distinguish 'the endpoint is broken' from 'this parameter value is rejected'. The variable that mattered was never varied, so the second run added confidence without adding information. To its credit this manifest did hedge - it listed a 'server-side bug specific to this collection/page-size combination' among possible causes - but the headline conclusion still reads as an upstream fault.
correction_note_appended_2026-08-01.the_actual_cause: A page-size fault, not an upstream outage and not a broken endpoint. The endpoint was never down. page[size]=200 returns HTTP 500 with an HTML error body; page[size]=20 and page[size]=50 both return HTTP 200 with valid JSON.
correction_note_appended_2026-08-01.precision_on_the_word_deterministic: Deterministic in every scripted run (this run 5/5 failed at 200, the prior run 5/5 failed at 200, the probe 1/1 failed at 200). Near-deterministic across ALL known attempts: the prior run's manifest records 1 success out of 3 manual curl tests at 200, making it 1 success in ~14 known attempts. Stated at this precision deliberately rather than rounding to 'always fails', per CLAUDE.md rule 11.
correction_note_appended_2026-08-01.sole_evidence: A single read-only probe performed 2026-07-31 (filed 2026-08-01) against pinned version 4.9.0-LIVE.12232306, one request per page size, no retries: size 20 -> HTTP 200, application/json, 20 records; size 50 -> HTTP 200, application/json, 50 records; size 200 -> HTTP 500, text/html, 40,622 bytes. That probe is the ONLY evidence for this correction. No other test has been run.
correction_note_appended_2026-08-01.also_corrected_in_code: get_with_retry in scripts/external_sources/api_star_citizen_wiki.py carried a comment calling the failure 'intermittent' and 'transient', which is why retrying was treated as the answer. That comment now records the correction instead of the disproven claim.
correction_note_appended_2026-08-01.resolution: Fixed via PAGE_SIZE_OVERRIDES (vehicles=50; items and manufacturers stay at 200). Verified by run 20260801T021731Z, which landed all 295 vehicles across 6 pages, matching the API's own reported total, with zero pages rejected by the write gate.
correction_note_appended_2026-08-01.status_of_this_snapshot: Unchanged by this note. snapshot_status stays 'partial' and its stated reason stays true - vehicles genuinely returned 0 usable records in this run. This correction addresses the recorded DIAGNOSIS only; no data, count, hash, status or acquisition field is altered.
